name: eventbridge-sample
description: Shared EventBridge bus provisioned by a resources-only stack, a producer that PutEvents to it, and a consumer whose eventBridge-triggered Lambda runs in LSS — no serverless deploy, no serverless-offline.

scripts.register:all: npm run register:events && npm run register:producer && npm run register:consumer
scripts.setup: npm --prefix events-stack install && npm --prefix producer-service install && npm --prefix consumer-service install
